output.plain_english: Every night this job works through a queue of billing adjustments. It reprices a line if the client has a rate override, holds large write-downs until a partner approves them, and writes everything else straight into the billing tables.

steps.text: Reads queued adjustments due by the run date, with each line's billable value, partner and any client rate override.
Reprices the line first when the client has a rate override.
For a write-down above the limit, checks for a partner approval and holds the line if there is none.
Records a pending approval, only once per billing line.
Writes the new value into the billing line and marks the queue item processed.

hidden_rules.text: Write-downs above 10% of the billable value need partner approval. This appears nowhere except the code.
The test uses the repriced value, so a rate override can change whether approval is needed.
Write-ups never need approval: only adjustment type D is tested.

cloud_blockers.text: Direct update of the billing line.
Direct insert into a custom approval table.
Direct update of a custom queue table.
